text:
Alex: Heads-up — a customer hit repeated midstream failovers during long-running streaming calls; gateway returned 502 after the reconnect handshake a few times, so the client retried and we ended up duplicating some tokens.
Mai: Can you paste the minimal log snippet? was it the edge aborting or the upstream dropping the connection?
Alex: Logs show upstream reset then gateway timed out trying to re-establish session. snippet:
```
2026-03-19T15:02:11Z edge: connection lost to shard-3 (RST)
2026-03-19T15:02:11Z gateway: attempt resume -> upstream not supporting resume: 404
2026-03-19T15:02:12Z gateway: fallback -> proxied reconnect (new session)
2026-03-19T15:02:13Z gateway: upstream returned 502 on new session
```
Sam: Ok — two orthogonal problems: 1) resume semantics / handoff protocol between client-edge-upstream; 2) observable counters to figure recurrence and cost.
Jordan: For resume: we should decide whether edge owns the resume window (keep KV cache & buffer) or ask upstream to provide opaque resume tokens that encode state. Both have tradeoffs: edge-owned -> memory blowup, upstream-owned -> requires model runtime changes.
Priya: Also call out side effects: if a streaming request triggered external side effects midstream, resuming vs replaying can duplicate effects. We need an idempotency contract.
Mai: Proposal: minimal incremental approach first: 1) expose clear observability (metrics/traces) so ops can tell resume vs full-reconnect; 2) add optional headers so clients can opt-in to resume semantics; 3) implement stateless fallback that avoids replay by returning an explicit non-resumable marker to the client.
Sam: Metrics to add: `edge.stream.resume_attempts`, `edge.stream.resume_success`, `edge.stream.fallback_count`, and histogram `edge.stream.resume_latency_ms`. Also tag by `model_variant`, `region`, `tenant_id`.
Jordan: Header API sketch: clients send `X-Resume-Token: <opaque>` when reconnecting; edge validates token lifetime and either issues `X-Resume-Accepted: yes` or `X-Resume-Accepted: no; reason=...`. Also require `X-Idempotency-Key` for any request that causes side effects. Example: 
```
POST /v1/stream
X-Idempotency-Key: 1234-abc
X-Resume-Token: 9876-def  # optional on reconnect
```
Priya: I like the idempotency header. For side-effecting ops we should reject resume unless `X-Idempotency-Key` is present and has been recorded upstream. Otherwise we should force a full restart and mark client-visible error that it's non-resumable.
Alex: Memory/cost question: if edge keeps buffered tokens for resume, we need eviction and bounds. Sam, estimate cost for 1000 concurrent resumes with 30s buffer?
Sam: Rough calc: average buffer 150KB per stream -> 150MB for 1k streams. Add overhead -> ~200MB. That's ok for a single node but scales. We need global limits and an eviction LRU. Also lease TTL: resume tokens expire after e.g., 60s.
Mai: Backoff strategy for clients: recommend exponential backoff with full jitter, base=200ms, cap=30s, max attempts=6. Document in API docs.
Jordan: Observability note: include structured trace field `resume_flow=true` and emit `resume_step` events: `token_check`, `state_recover`, `fallback`. This will help runbooks.
infra-bot: Incident created: #INC-20260319-42 linked to thread 3912345678
Alex: Quick decision needed for short-term RFC follow-up: implement metrics + headers + enforce resume-token TTL + non-resumable marker. Longer term we evaluate pushing resume to upstream runtime.
Priya: Agreed. I'll draft a short RFC for the header semantics and idempotency contract (will include examples for ack-less streams).
Sam: I'll add the metric names to the ingestion schema and a dashboard template.
Jordan: I'll prototype the `X-Resume-*` header handling in the edge proxy codepath and add unit tests for token expiry and accept/reject flows.
Mai: Plan sounds good. Can we add an alert: `edge.stream.resume_failure_rate > 5%` over 5m to P99 pager?
Alex: Yes — add that to the dashboard and low-noise pager config.
Priya: small TODO: define client error code for "non-resumable" so SDKs can surface proper guidance. Suggest `498 Non-Resumable` with body explaining next steps.
Alex: Perfect. Thanks all. :+1:
Mai: I'll follow up with the RFC link and the dashboard PR.
Sam: landing PR for metrics later today.
Jordan: prototype branch up shortly.
infra-bot: Deployed alert rule: edge.stream.resume_failure_rate -> staging.
